Maya (sales): Heads up — POC kickoff tomorrow with SG team. They pinned model "redwood-app-large-v1" but calls from ap-sg are failing. Need triage + quick dedicated trial pricing + short security answers. Log snippet below.

Diego (se): Paste the exact request and any error ids. Did they pin by name or manifest id?

Maya (sales): They used "model: "redwood-app-large-v1"". Proxy log:
[2026-11-02T06:22:10Z] req=ab9f1 model=redwood-app-large-v1 region=ap-sg status=404 err=MODEL_NOT_FOUND
[2026-11-02T06:22:11Z] req=ab9f2 model=redwood-app-large-v1 region=ap-sg status=429 err=NO_FALLBACK

Rina (infra): Looks like that exact variant isn't staged in ap-sg. Fast options: (1) enable account-level alias fallback to a deployed compatible variant (e.g., redwood-app-large-v1-quant), or (2) provision a 14-day Dedicated pool (2x A100-eq). Manifest push for exact artifact takes ~24-48h.

Kofi (security): They asked about KMS separation, SOC2 docs, and log residency. Hosted gives SOC2 and encryption; for strict residency we need Dedicated/Private. I can prepare a one-page pack.

Diego (se): Short-term workaround: if customer agrees, enable fallback mapping and ask them to set header `x-allow-fallback: 1` for the POC. Note: quantized variant may differ in latency/quality.

Infra-bot: Deployment lookup:
- redwood-app-large-v1: manifest M-2b7a deployed: us-west, eu-west
- redwood-app-large-v1-quant: manifest M-2b7a-q deployed: ap-sg (replicas:3)

Rina (infra): Confirmed. Alias fallback will unblock in ~60-90 minutes once we get written consent. Dedicated trial pricing ballpark: infra cost ~$10k-$13k for 2 GPUs x14d; recommend quoting $18k including ops/support.

Maya (sales): Customer contact is liew.soh@examplecorp.com. I'll ask if they're OK with fallback. Please prep the quote and security pack.

Deploy-bot: Ticket INF-4678 created "AP-SG POC: alias fallback + trial quote" assigned to infra, se, security.

Maya (sales): Update — customer agreed to try fallback variant for POC and accepts note about possible differences. Please enable and monitor.

Rina (infra): Applying alias now. Will post back when smoke tests pass.

Infra-bot: Alias rule applied for acct-774: pinned=redwood-app-large-v1 -> redwood-app-large-v1-quant in ap-sg. Quick tests returning 200; watching for 429 under load.

Diego (se): Great. Maya, send the security pack and the quote. If they later request exact parity we can plan a manifest push (1-2 day window).

Maya (sales): Thanks everyone — closing loop with the customer now.
